constants.name: msoLightingBottom

enumerations.name: MsoPresetLightingSoftness

enumerations.name: MsoPresetMaterial

enumerations.name: MsoPresetTextEffect
enumerations.description: Specifies what text effect to use on a WordArt object. Refer to the WordArt Gallery dialog box in any Microsoft Office product that supports WordArt to see a preview of each effect. The values of the MsoPresetTextEffect constants correspond to the formats listed in the WordArt Gallery dialog box (numbered from left to right and from top to bottom).

enumerations.name: MsoPresetTextEffectShape
enumerations.description: Specifies shape of WordArt text. You can see a preview of each text effect shape by selecting WordArt Shape on the WordArt toolbar.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeStop
constants.description: Text follows the shape of a stop sign.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeChevronUp
constants.description: Text slants down to its center point and then slants up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeChevronDown
constants.description: Text slants up to its center point and then slants down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeRingInside
constants.description: Text appears to be written inside a 3D ring.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeRingOutside
constants.description: Text appears to be written outside a 3D ring.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchUpCurve
constants.description: Text is an arch that curves up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchDownCurve
constants.description: Text is an arch that curves down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCircleCurve
constants.description: Text follows a circle, reading clockwise.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeButtonCurve
constants.description: Text is curved around a center "button."

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchUpPour
constants.description: Text is a 3D arch that curves up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchDownPour
constants.description: Text is a 3D arch that curves down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCirclePour
constants.description: Text has a 3D effect and follows a circle, reading clockwise.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeButtonPour
constants.description: Text is seen in 3D, curved around a center "button."

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCurveUp
constants.description: Text curves down and to the right as font size increases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCurveDown
constants.description: Text curves down and to the right as font size decreases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCanUp
constants.description: Text is stretched to fill the height of the shape, with only a slight curve up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCanDown
constants.description: Text is stretched to fill the height of the shape, with only a slight curve down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeWave1
constants.description: Text follows a wave up, then down and up again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeWave2
constants.description: Text follows a wave down, then up and down again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDoubleWave1
constants.description: Text follows a line that curves up, then down, then up and down again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDoubleWave2
constants.description: Text follows a line that curves down, then up, then down and up again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflate
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter is on the same straight line.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflate
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflateBottom
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter follows an arch that curves downward.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateBottom
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size, while keeping the top of the text along the same curve.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflateTop
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter follows an arch that curves upward.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateTop
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size, while keeping the bottom of the text along the same curve.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateInflate
constants.description: Font size increases to the text's midpoint, then decreases to the starting size.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateInflateDeflate
constants.description: Font size decreases, increases, and decreases again across the text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeRight
constants.description: Right side of text appears to be closer to the viewer than left side.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeLeft
constants.description: Left side of text appears to be closer to the viewer than right side.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeUp
constants.description: Bottom of text appears to be closer to the viewer than top.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeDown
constants.description: Top of the text appears to be closer to the viewer than bottom of the text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeSlantUp
constants.description: Text slants up and to the right.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeSlantDown
constants.description: Text slants down and to the right.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCascadeUp
constants.description: Text slants down and to the right as font size increases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCascadeDown
constants.description: Text slants up and to the right as font size decreases.

constants.name: msoAfterLastSibling

enumerations.name: MsoScaleFrom
enumerations.description: Specifies which part of the shape retains its position when the shape is scaled.

constants.name: msoScaleFromTopLeft

constants.name: msoScaleFromBottomRight

enumerations.name: MsoSegmentType

constants.name: msoShadowStyleMixed
constants.description: Specifies a combination of inner and outer shadow effects.

constants.name: msoShadow16

constants.name: msoShadow18

constants.name: msoShadow19

constants.name: msoShadow29

constants.name: msoShadow37

enumerations.description: Specifies constants that define the types of SmartArt nodes.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeTypeAssistant

enumerations.name: MsoSoftEdgeType
enumerations.description: Represents the soft edge effect in Office graphics.

enumerations.name: MsoSyncConflictResolutionType
enumerations.description: Specifies how conflicts should be resolved when synchronizing a shared document. Used with the ResolveConflict method of the Sync object.

constants.name: msoSyncConflictClientWins
constants.description: Replace the server copy with the local copy.

constants.name: msoSyncConflictServerWins
constants.description: Replace the local copy with the server copy.

constants.name: msoSyncConflictMerge
constants.description: Merge changes made to the server copy into the local copy. To resolve the conflict with the merged changes winning, you must save the active document after merging changes, and then call the ResolveConflict method again with the msoSyncConflictClientWins option.

enumerations.name: MsoSyncErrorType
enumerations.description: Specifies a document synchronization error.

constants.name: msoSyncErrorCouldNotCompare
constants.description: Source and destination files could not be compared.

enumerations.name: MsoSyncEventType
enumerations.description: Specifies the return value of a Sync event. In Microsoft Word, used with the Sync event of the Document object or the DocumentSync event of the Application object. In Microsoft Excel, used with the Sync event of the Workbook object or the WorkbookSync event of the Application object. In Microsoft PowerPoint, used with the PresentationSync event of the Application object.

enumerations.name: MsoSyncStatusType
enumerations.description: Specifies the status of the synchronization of the local copy of the active document with the server copy. Used with the Status property of the Sync object.

constants.name: msoSyncStatusConflict
constants.description: Both the local and the server copies have changes.

constants.name: msoSyncStatusError
constants.description: An error occurred. Use the ErrorType property of the Sync object to determine the exact error.

enumerations.name: MsoSyncVersionType
enumerations.description: Specifies which version of a shared document to open alongside the currently open local version.

constants.name: msoSyncVersionLastViewed
constants.description: Opens the copy of the document that is created whenever the user overwrites the local copy with the server copy.

enumerations.name: MsoTabStopType

constants.name: msoTabStopMixed

enumerations.name: MsoTargetBrowser
enumerations.description: Specifies target browser for documents viewed in a web browser.

constants.name: msoTargetBrowserV3
constants.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer 3.0, Netscape Navigator 3, or later

constants.name: msoTargetBrowserV4
constants.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer 4.0, Netscape Navigator 4, or later

enumerations.name: MsoTextCaps
enumerations.description: Specifies the capitalization of the text.

constants.name: msoCapsMixed
constants.description: Display the text as mixed uppercase and lowercase letters.

constants.name: msoNoCaps
constants.description: Display the text with no uppercase letters.

constants.name: msoSmallCaps
constants.description: Display the text with all lowercase letters.

constants.name: msoAllCaps
constants.description: Display the text as all uppercase letters.

enumerations.name: MsoTextChangeCase
enumerations.description: Specifies the capitalization of text.

constants.name: msoCaseSentence
constants.description: Display the text as sentence case characters. Sentence case specifies that the first letter of the sentence is capitalized and that all others should be lowercase (with some exceptions such as proper nouns, and acronyms).

constants.name: msoCaseLower
constants.description: Display the text as lowercase characters.

constants.name: msoCaseUpper
constants.description: Display the text as uppercase characters.

constants.name: msoCaseTitle
constants.description: Display the text as title case characters. Title case specifies that the first letter of each word is capitalized and that all others should be lowercase. In some cases short articles, prepositions, and conjunctions are not capitalized.

constants.name: msoCaseToggle
constants.description: Indicates that lowercase text should be converted to uppercase and that uppercase text should be converted to lowercase text.

enumerations.name: MsoTextCharWrap
enumerations.description: Indicates the type of text wrap.

constants.name: msoStandardCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies wrapping text around the standard boundary of an object.

constants.name: msoStrictCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies text wrapping that adheres to restrictions imposed by some languages such as Chinese and Japanese alphabets.

constants.name: msoCustomCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies a custom text wrap scheme.

enumerations.name: MsoTextDirection
enumerations.description: Specifies the direction that text runs.

constants.name: msoTextDirectionMixed
constants.description: Return value only; indicates a combination of the other states.

enumerations.name: MsoTextEffectAlignment
enumerations.description: Specifies alignment for WordArt text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentLetterJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Spacing between letters may be adjusted to justify text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentWordJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Spacing between words (but not letters) may be adjusted to justify text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentStretchJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Letters may be stretched to justify text.

enumerations.name: MsoTextFontAlign
enumerations.description: Indicates the text alignment scheme used for an object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignMixed
constants.description: Specifies that there is a mix of text alignments used with the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignAuto
constants.description: Specifies that the text alignment will be determined by the Office application.

constants.name: msoFontAlignTop
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the top of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignCenter
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the center of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignBaseline
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the baseline of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignBottom
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the bottom of the object.

enumerations.name: MsoTextOrientation
enumerations.description: Specifies orientation for text.

constants.name: msoTextOrientationVerticalFarEast
constants.description: Vertical as required for Asian language support

constants.name: msoTextOrientationHorizontalRotatedFarEast
constants.description: Horizontal and rotated as required for Asian language support

enumerations.name: MsoTextStrike
enumerations.description: Indicates the number of times a character is printed to darken the image.

constants.name: msoStrikeMixed
constants.description: Specifies that the text can contain a combination of doublestrike and single strike characters.

constants.name: msoNoStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is not printed.

constants.name: msoSingleStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is printed once.

constants.name: msoDoubleStrike
constants.description: Specifies that the character is printed twice.

enumerations.name: MsoTextTabAlign
enumerations.description: Indicates the text alignment against tab stops or line breaks.

constants.name: msoTabAlignMixed
constants.description: Specifies that mixed text alignment against tab stops is used.

constants.name: msoTabAlignLeft
constants.description: Specifies that the following text starts immediately after the designated tab stop (the default).

constants.name: msoTabAlignCenter
constants.description: Specifies that the following text up to next tab or line break is centered on the designated tab stop.

constants.name: msoTabAlignRight
constants.description: Specifies that the following text up to the next tab or line break is rendered flush right to the designated tab stop.

constants.name: msoTabAlignDecimal
constants.description: Specifies that the following text is searched for the first occurrence of the character representing the decimal point. The text up to the next tab or line break is then aligned such that the decimal point starts at the designated tab stop.

enumerations.name: MsoTextUnderlineType

constants.description: Specifies a mixed of underline types.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDottedHeavyLine
constants.description: Specifies a dotted heavy line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDashLongLine
constants.description: Specifies a dashed long line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDashLongHeavyLine
constants.description: Specifies a long heavy line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDotDashLine
constants.description: Specifies a dot dash line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDotDashHeavyLine
constants.description: Specifies a dot dash heavy line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDotDotDashLine
constants.description: Specifies a dot dot dash line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineDotDotDashHeavyLine
constants.description: Specifies a dot dot dash heavy line underline.

constants.name: msoUnderlineWavyHeavyLine

constants.name: msoUnderlineWavyDoubleLine

constants.description: Specifies a color scheme for a clicked hyperlink.

enumerations.description: Specifies a tri-state value.

enumerations.description: Specifies the vertical alignment of text in a text frame. Used with the VerticalAnchor property of the TextFrame object.

constants.description: Return value only; indicates a combination of the other states.

constants.name: msoAnchorTop
constants.description: Aligns text to top of text frame.

constants.name: msoAnchorTopBaseline
constants.description: Anchors top of text string to current position, regardless of text resizing. When you resize text without baseline anchoring, text centers itself on previous position.

constants.name: msoAnchorBottom
constants.description: Aligns text to bottom of text frame.

constants.name: msoAnchorBottomBaseLine
constants.description: Anchors bottom of text string to current position, regardless of text resizing. When you resize text without baseline anchoring, text centers itself on previous position.

enumerations.name: MsoWarpFormat
enumerations.description: Indicates various image warping formats.

constants.name: msoWarpFormatMixed
constants.description: Specifies a mix of warp formats.

constants.name: msoWizardMsgShowHelp
constants.description: User clicked the left button in the decision or branch balloon.
